name: Sanguine Aristocracy
identity: Vampire nobles, their deathless levies and blood-knights. Few, deadly duelists that heal by killing: if they are kept from fighting, they wither; if they reach the line, they top up and keep going.

rules.name: The Hunger
rules.description: At the end of a Fight action in which a Sanguine unit destroyed 1+ enemy models, it heals 2 MIGHT (3 if it destroyed the whole enemy unit). For a multi-model unit, healing goes to its most damaged model first, then returns 1 slain model per 2 points left (never above Starting Strength).

rules.name: Gamble — The Red Thirst
rules.description: When a unit activates: +1 Attack in melee and +2″ to Charge rolls this activation, but it must declare a Charge against the closest visible enemy unit if able, and its CTRL is 0 until it next activates. (Risk: objective / position.)

detachments.name: Blood Court
detachments.playstyle: Lords and duelists hunting the enemy's heroes.

rules.name: Court of Duellists
rules.description: Sanguine Leaders gain [PRECISION] in melee; each enemy Leader destroyed by a Sanguine Leader heals that Leader fully.

enhancements.name: Heart-Seeker Blade
enhancements.description: **Crimson Duelist-Countess** only. Melee critical wounds become Fatal Wounds.

stratagems.name: Issue the Challenge
stratagems.effect: Choose an enemy Leader within 3″: both must fight each other this activation.

stratagems.name: Blood-Quickened
stratagems.turn: A Leader heals from The Hunger

stratagems.name: Noble Disdain
stratagems.turn: A Leader is targeted by a ranged attack
stratagems.effect: −1 to Wound against it for the attack.

detachments.name: Grave Cavalcade
detachments.playstyle: Grave-Knights and hounds running down the wounded.

rules.name: Scent of Blood
rules.description: +2″ to Move and Charge toward an enemy unit below Starting Strength.

enhancements.name: Banner of the Cavalcade
enhancements.description: **Blood-Sorcerer** only. Friendly units within 6″ get +1 to Hit in melee on a round they charged.

stratagems.name: Ride Them Down
stratagems.turn: A Class 2 cavalry unit ends a Charge

stratagems.name: Hunt the Weak
stratagems.turn: A unit targets a unit below Half-Strength

stratagems.name: Spectral Steeds
stratagems.effect: It may move over terrain and models.

detachments.name: Midnight Court
detachments.playstyle: Mist, summoning and the deathless levy that will not stay down.

rules.name: Endless Night
rules.description: Once per round, at the End of Round, one unengaged Sanguine unit more than 6″ from enemies may redeploy wholly within 6″ of a table edge, more than 8″ from enemies. Gravesite Summoning costs 1 CP instead of 2.

enhancements.name: Grimoire of the Grave
enhancements.description: **Blood-Sorcerer** only. Raised Again returns D3+1 models.

stratagems.name: Rise, Rise!
stratagems.turn: A Class 1 Deathless or Levy unit activates

stratagems.name: Fog of the Crypt
stratagems.turn: An enemy unit targets a unit within 6″ of a table edge

stratagems.name: Blood Tithe
stratagems.turn: A Levy model is removed by Blood Cattle
